aboutIntro:
Opened in 2021, The Knot Climbing Gym is a full-service indoor rock climbing gym that offers climbing, yoga, and other forms of fitness.

We aim to provide an experience that is accessible and enriches the lives of members, guests, and the surrounding community.

Climbing is at the heart of everything we do. We strive to create a memorable experience for all who visit our facility. At the heart of our brand is a team of skilled, passionate routesetters, instructors, and staff who are here to help you reach your climbing goals.

missionStatement.text: "We exist, and strive, to facilitate meaningful friendships, connections, and community for our members, guests & staff. In every interaction, we seek to enrich lives and provide a sense of belonging through the climbing experience, our programs, and community partnerships."

coreValues.title: CONSCIOUSLY AWARE
coreValues.subheading: Check your knots, check your blindspots, and check yourself.
coreValues.content: We check, and double-check, the critical equipment on which we and others rely. We keep our eyes open and seek 360-degree visibility of our surroundings. We remind ourselves that the opportunity to pursue our goals and dreams comes from a place of extreme privilege; because of this, we actively work towards greater equity and inclusivity so others may share in this privilege.

coreValues.title: RADICALLY BOLD
coreValues.content: We calculate the risks and decide to act in spite of fear. This courage can manifest in many ways: climbing scary routes, building a business, or even dyeing our hair. We celebrate taking steps outside our comfort zone.

coreValues.title: IMPACT DRIVEN
coreValues.content: As part of a community, we understand our actions reverberate beyond us and so we strive for positive change. Our impact isn't just a consideration - it's a driving force. (An impact driver also happens to be a tool that helps us create the routes.)

coreValues.title: REMAIN AUTHENTIC
coreValues.content: We can only be who we are in this world. We're proud of ourselves and our Florida roots. Though we may outgrow our swampy pastures, our growth will always remain authentic to the variety of influences and experiences that make us unique.

coreValues.title: GET STOKED, STAY STOKED
coreValues.subheading: Amplify the spark that moves people.
coreValues.content: Encouraging and inspiring individuals to improve beyond what they thought possible - that's what gets us up in the morning.

meetTheTeamIntro: A business is only as good as their team of people. Lucky for us, our team is incredible. We hope you get a chance to meet every friendly, knowledgeable face on staff during your time at the gym.

faqItems.title: DO YOU OFFER DAY PASSES?
faqItems.content: Yes! We offer day passes for $25 which includes access to all climbing areas, yoga classes, and the training area. Rental gear is available for an additional fee. Day passes are a great way to try out the gym before committing to a membership.

faqItems.title: WHAT'S INCLUDED WITH MY MEMBERSHIP?
faqItems.content: Your membership includes unlimited access to all climbing areas (bouldering and top-rope), yoga classes, the training area, and gear rentals. Members also receive discounts at local partner businesses and priority registration for events and classes.

faqItems.title: HOW DOES BILLING WORK?
faqItems.content: Memberships are billed monthly on the first of the month. When you join, you only pay for the remaining days in your first month, then $80/month thereafter. You can manage your billing, freeze your membership, or cancel anytime through the member portal.

faqItems.title: HOW DO I GIVE FEEDBACK?
faqItems.content: Enjoyed the gym or think something could be improved? Let us know your thoughts! Have other questions? Send us an email instead at info@climbtheknot.com
